intake-preview.default_prompt: Use $intake-preview to preview how repo-local notes, markdown, or DOCX research would change the current git-slop backlog.
intake-preview.short_description: Preview how local research would change the backlog

intake.default_prompt: Use $intake to ingest repo-local notes, markdown, or DOCX research into the current git-slop backlog with the minimum evidence-backed GitHub updates.
intake.short_description: Ingest local research and apply resulting backlog changes

review-to-backlog-preview.default_prompt: Use $review-to-backlog-preview to review the current git-slop repository and preview the backlog issues that material findings should become.
review-to-backlog-preview.short_description: Preview backlog-ready issues from repo review findings

review-to-backlog-apply.default_prompt: Use $review-to-backlog-apply to review the current git-slop repository and create or update the backlog issues that material findings should become.
review-to-backlog-apply.short_description: Turn material repo review findings into backlog issues

ensure-quarter-milestones.default_prompt: Use $ensure-quarter-milestones to ensure the current and next git-slop quarter milestones exist and match policy.
ensure-quarter-milestones.short_description: Create or refresh the current and next quarter milestones

plan-quarter-preview.default_prompt: Use $plan-quarter-preview to preview which git-slop issues should be explicitly committed to a target quarter.
plan-quarter-preview.short_description: Preview which issues should be committed to a quarter

plan-quarter-apply.default_prompt: Use $plan-quarter-apply to apply reviewed git-slop quarter commitments and record the rationale in GitHub.
plan-quarter-apply.short_description: Apply quarter commitments and record GitHub rationale

github-backlog-mutate.default_prompt: Use $github-backlog-mutate to apply a reviewed issue-centric git-slop backlog mutation plan when the change spans issues, milestones, and project fields.
github-backlog-mutate.short_description: Apply a reviewed mixed backlog mutation plan in GitHub

label-palette-design.default_prompt: Use $label-palette-design to preview or refresh the deterministic git-slop GitHub label palette.
label-palette-design.short_description: Design or refresh the deterministic backlog label palette
